answer: The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, published publicly on failure, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the reef of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. A harbor of per-task receipts records who did what, and the wharf of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
